title: Chapter 17 Regular Army
content:
Chapter 17 Regular Army

On Wu Qing's first night in Daxia Territory, he did not choose to go to bed quietly.

He summoned all the Zerg troops in Daxia and went out of the city to find strange trouble.

The commotion outside made all the territory residents feel panicked and unable to sleep peacefully.

Wu Qing first led the Zerg troops to sweep the area where the Lord's protection was weakened. Each host was a spiritual searchlight. They swept back and forth in the fields outside the city and discovered many weak and strange things.

These weirdos are similar in strength to possessed weirdos. There are various spiritual energy bodies, and there are also some weird creatures that are contaminated and distorted.

Although they entered the weakened area of lord protection, their strength was once again suppressed. They were pitifully weak and could only bully ordinary people.

With just one mental shock from the host, they were all finished.

After the sweep was completed and some gains were made, Wu Qing was no longer satisfied with staying in the weakened area of lord protection. He organized the Zerg troops and found a spacious border position.

On one side here is the weakened area of lord protection, and on the other side is the area for weird and free activities.

Wu Qing first asked a host to wander around the strange free activity area, and found that there seemed to be some terrifying existence lurking in the darkness, so he asked the host to come back.

If you really want to drag the team out and go out for a wander, it probably won't end well.

"It's too risky to go out directly. If you lose too much, it won't be worth the gain."

"Just lure the monsters over here."

Wu Qing weighed it up and decided not to be reckless. He asked all the hydralisks to line up and sent a puppy out to run around, which immediately attracted a bunch of polluted and twisted creatures.

When these things entered the attack range of the Hydralisk, they were attacked from a distance.

As soon as the war started, the place became lively, like a hornet's nest.

Countless strange things appeared in the dark night, and there were all kinds of strange sounds all around. It was very scary and refreshed Wu Qing's understanding.

Wu Qing stood on the castle and commanded remotely without being actually affected.

With the protection of a rule-level lord, even if it is a weakened area, ordinary weirdness will not dare to enter, only those special weirdness can enter.

Weiyi, who was outside the protection of the lord, faced the attack of the hydralisk, and was helpless and furious. There was nothing he could do.

Those weird puppies and hosts that can enter the weakened area of the Lord's protection will not be polite and will die if they enter.

After doing this for a while, the remaining weirdness receded. It was a little weird, but he was not a fool and would not let Wu Qing take advantage of it.

Wu Qing changed several directions and used the same method to pick up Weird's wool. After a few times, this method no longer worked, and the Weirds around him became smarter.

Having gained a lot, Wu Qing returned the Zerg army with satisfaction.

The resources harvested tonight will be used to continue to develop the Zerg territory and increase the number of Hydralisks and puppies, except for leaving a small amount for emergency manufacturing.

At night, Wu Qing was not used to the sudden absence of Weird singing.

He was not used to living in the lord's castle where the kobold lived, so he sat cross-legged at the highest point of the castle and used meditation instead of sleeping.

At dawn the next day, Wu Qing sent out his puppies to explore and reconnoiter around Daxia Territory, especially the direction from which the bugbears came.

There is no exact source of information about the current situation in the surrounding area. What the kobold lord said is vague and not necessarily trustworthy.

What Hu Tu said was what he had heard from hearsay, and it was difficult to tell the truth from the lies.

Only what you see is the most real.

Most of the residents in Daxia Territory, like Wu Qing, got up early at dawn. Many of them had dark circles under their eyes. Wu Qing's behavior in taking the initiative to go out to fight strange things at night was beyond the imagination of the residents.

They were worried and frightened, and their sleep was affected.

When they looked at the Zerg again, they became more respectful, their eyes full of admiration and awe.

He has to run out to fight weird races at night, and he must not be offended.

As a result, everyone's recognition of the new lord increased, and the luck of the Great Xia Territory increased.

This can be regarded as an accident and an unexpected surprise.

Wu Qing had no time to feel this little surprise now. The puppy's latest discovery forced him to take all the Zerg combat troops back to the Zerg territory.

The Great Xia leader only left the host to sit in and calm people's hearts.

As the Zerg army evacuates, the residents in the city will inevitably become panicked. The time has come to test the Queen's management ability.

The reason for leaving in such a hurry was that the puppy discovered the bugbear army in the east of Bactria's territory.

The bugbear army discovered this time was completely different from the one they fought last time. They were all over two meters tall, wearing thick leather armor, and the weapons in their hands changed from wooden sticks to maces full of iron spikes. .

The number of this army is in the early 2000s. The army is neat and powerful, and the proportion of lizard knights has also increased.

"Compared with this army, the bugbears we fought last time can only be regarded as militiamen."

"This is what a regular army should look like!"

This is Wu Qing's evaluation of this army.

The puppy set out at dawn, and not long after the time passed, he encountered this regular army of bugbears.

The distance between the two sides is not far, and it won't take long for this army to come over.

This army is powerful. If the Zerg hide, they can temporarily avoid the edge, but the newly established Great Xia Territory will have to be destroyed. This is something Wu Qing cannot tolerate.

You can only do it hard!

"I only had a peaceful day!"

"However, such a powerful army must be able to provide a lot of resources."

"It's time for the Zerg to show its strongest advantage!"

Wu Qing began to count the number of combat arms. There were 788 puppies and 150 hydralisks.

The number of worker bees has increased to 100, and the number of mother nests has reached 15.

The 700 puppies and 150 hydralisks assembled under Wu Qing's command and began to rush to the preset battlefield selected by Wu Qing.

This battlefield cannot be too far away from the Zerg territory to facilitate replenishment, nor can it be too close to avoid losing buffer space.

100 worker bees are frantically mining minerals, and 15 mother nests are constantly hatching puppies.

As long as resources allow, 30 puppies can be replenished every two minutes.

It is still too inefficient to rely solely on worker bees to mine and provide resources.

The sun rose, and it was morning in a blink of an eye. Wu Qing had been waiting in the Zerg territory for a long time.

After the morning exercise, the army of the bear goblins began to eat breakfast. After breakfast, they cleaned up the temporary camp, reorganized the team, and then hurried on their way.

Everything was in order.

"These foreign races' armies are indeed extraordinary. No wonder they can suppress the local creatures."

Wu Qing observed the movements of the bear goblin army through the vision of the puppy, and had some understanding of these armies that frightened the dog-headed lords.

When the number of puppies on the preset battlefield finally exceeded 800, the regular army of the bear goblins finally arrived.
